## Record notes carried by the producers

**Objective family.** Paper A objective-family sensitivity sweep -- ALL SIX solute x variety panels (Paper 1 second review MC2: the manuscript previously claimed all three solutes and both varieties while only four panels had been run). Producer: puckworks.validation.slow.angeloni_bracket.identifiability_panel(...)['objective_family'] -- slow, hand-run, deterministic. Rate domain 0.15-6.5, 29-point geometric grid. Reproduction of the four previously recorded panels was verified exact.
